column7: STORAGE-ERR-CLASS-5 item 5: the handler pre-check fold class (a core read error answered 404 / codes.NotFound for every error, so a storage fault reads as a missing target) had no guard: the folded-read guard read only internal/core and server/middleware/auth.go. TestNoStorageReadErrorFoldedIntoNotFound now also scans server/http/handlers and server/grpc/services (report-only, docs/guard-rollout.d). The scanner is calibrated red on the CreateSecretAccessRequest, handler-Get and gRPC shapes and green on the classified shapes. Four hits found and not fixed are registered as deferred exceptions (catalog GetProject, groups GetGroup, secret templates Get, share status).
